CheckTitle: Ensure the default security group of every VPC restricts all traffic
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Description: Checks that default security groups have no inbound or outbound rules.
Risk: Resources launched without an explicit security group fall into the default group; permissive defaults silently expose them.

Code.CLI: aws ec2 revoke-security-group-ingress --group-id <default-sg> --ip-permissions <perm> && aws ec2 revoke-security-group-egress --group-id <default-sg> --ip-permissions <perm>

Recommendation.Text: Remove all inbound and outbound rules from every VPC's default security group and use purpose-built groups.
